text:
Sophie (Marketing): Quick sync — drafting a 1-pager for enterprise secure deploys (VPC/on-prem + SLAs). Goal: field-ready, one page, single slide. Who can take final copy this week? cc @Maria @Jake
Maria (Growth): I can. keep it concise (<200 words). Need: headline, 4 quick bullets ('why Redwood', 'deployment modes', 'security & compliance', 'next steps').
Jake (Product): I can supply the technical bullets and two callouts: 'dedicated pools' and 'automatic fallback policies'.
Kevin (Design): Design can do a clean wireframe. Prefer 2-column: left bullets, right visual of modes. I can mock today. :art: 
Alex (Field): Field needs a one-line 'decision starter' for CISO: private vs dedicated vs hosted. I'll draft.
Sophie (Marketing): Awesome. Maria — own tone (executive, concise) and final wordcount. Jake & Alex — drop 2 bullets each by EOD. Kevin — 1 PNG 1200x800.
Maria (Growth): Drafting headline options:
- 'Secure inference that scales — on your terms'
- 'SLA-backed inference across hosted, dedicated, private'
Which feels better for sales/field?
Alex (Field): Prefer option 1, sounds less salesy. Decision snippet draft:
'Private: full control + audit logs + KMS/HSM; Dedicated: reserved GPU pools for predictable throughput; Hosted: fastest time-to-value. Consider cost/ops tradeoffs.'
Jake (Product): Technical bullets (2):
- 'Private: VPC-based control plane, optional on-prem package, KMS/HSM integration, comprehensive audit logs'
- 'Dedicated: reserved GPU pools, autoscaling, SLA-backed latency & uptime, burst capacity options'
Also add: 'Smart routing with fallbacks to compatible model variants and quantization recommendations.'
Kevin (Design): Uploaded initial mock (placeholder): https://figma.com/s/3AbcXYZ — notes: green accent, lock/server/cloud icons, very clean header.
Sophie (Marketing): Can someone drop a 1-paragraph exec summary here by 4pm? I'll stitch and send to legal for quick review. :clock4:
Maria (Growth): Draft executive summary:
'Secure inference that scales — Redwood Inference gives product and platform teams a single API to run LLMs across hosted, dedicated, and private deployments. Customers get SLA-backed dedicated pools, private VPC/on-prem installs with KMS/HSM support, and smart routing with built-in fallbacks. Designed for regulated workloads, this one-pager highlights security controls, deployment tradeoffs, and recommended next steps for CISO and infra teams.'
Sophie (Marketing): :thumbsup: Love it. Jake, Alex — any edits? Otherwise I'll send to legal and Kevin will iterate design. Launch-bot, remind me tomorrow 10am to follow up.
launch-bot: Reminder set for 1718596399 (tomorrow 10:00). :robot_face:
Jake (Product): Small nit — add a line about cost ops: 'KV caching & batching to reduce per-token cost' after the fallbacks line.
Maria (Growth): Added: 'Includes caching and batching recommendations to optimize cost without sacrificing SLOs.'
Sophie (Marketing): Great. If legal sign-off by EOD Friday we aim to publish next Tue with a webinar teaser. Thanks team!
